newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms CT Financial, Canada Trust.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms CT Financial, Canada Trust.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Friday that it confirmed all of its credit ratings for CT Financial Services Inc and its wholly owned subsidiaries Canada Trust, Canada Trustco Mortgage Co and the Canada Trust Co with a stable trend.
The Toronto-based ratings agency said it confirmed all the ratings because the credit quality is respectable and remains superior to the major banks, despite some weakening in consumer lending.

"Overall CTFS's performance was favourabe in 1996, as reported earnings increased 19 percent to C$318 million, translating into a 14.3 percent return on total equity," Dominion Bond said in a statement.

DBRS rates CT Financial Services convertible debentures at AA (low), senior preference shares at Pfd-1, non-cumulative preference shares at Pfd-1 (low) and short-term debt instruments at R-1 (middle).

Dominion rates Canada Trust at AA and R-1 (middle). It rates Canada Trustco Mortgage Co and the Canada Trust Co long-term deposits at AA, convertible and capital debentures at AA (low), first preference shares at Pfd-1, second and third preference shares at Pfd-1 (low) and short-term deposits and notes at R-1 middle.
